segments.text: Hey guys, my three biggest keys to success in this industry.
First and foremost is a positive attitude.
Attitude is 50% of the job.
It's not always easy.
The job is full of no's.
Every no gets you closer to a yes, right?
Every morning brings a new opportunity as well.
So having an attitude that's just really positive, really hungry, stay motivated.
One day, one little result can change the entire outlook of a week.
So attitude is the number one thing that's going to make you successful in this company.
Number two is have a growing attitude, right?
Or a growing mentality.
Come in ready to grow every single day.
Learn new things.
Role play every single day.
Teach other people, you know?
One of the fastest ways to know what you know is to teach other people.
And if you can teach someone else how to do what you do, then you really are a master of
your craft.
And the third thing I would say is goal setting, right?
Don't come here and say, I'm going to try real hard and whatever happens, happens.
Don't be reactionary.
You have to write your own destiny.
So what you want to do is you want to create your goals and then you want to make them long
and big lofty goals so that you can grow out of your comfort zone.
And as you grow with us, the goal will be to make these goals bigger and bigger and bigger,
scarier and scarier and scarier.
And then watch you grow to somewhere you've never thought you could be in your life.
